answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32733 Country: India Title: about the imam sahab being opposed by peoples Question: some of the people are opposing imam sahab who is working as pesh imam for 9 yrs in mosque peoples are saying that he is not hafiz imam sahab is not confirming that please suggest is it right or wrong to pray to allah behind that imam sahab? Answer ID: 32733 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1165/670/D=1432) On what basis they are opposing? If the imam is able to recite the holy Quran correctly along with fulfilling all other conditions, then his imamah is alright. It is not a condition for the imam to be Hafiz, only it is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
